title: Thin and best suited for drying dogs off
text: Thin and best suited for drying dogs off. These sre listed as bath "sheets" and they are if you're going by size alone. However, our other bath sheets are much thicker than these. These are soft after washing, but the material is thin and nearly as absorbent as they need to be. Mine are white and they still shed lint and fiber even after three washings. I'm just putting these in our dog towel pile for dog bath days.
